gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

perplexity.config: page_size=32, max_active_pages=1, one page per tier -- chosen so the passage actually cascades through the compressed tiers
perplexity.note: Measured token-by-token through the cache under test, so the cache is actually exercised. A batched scoring pass would bypass it and report a meaningless zero delta. Unaffected by the logits_to_keep harness fix, which only concerns prefill logits.
perplexity.caveat: Only fp8 (2x, near-lossless) was reached at this passage length. The deeper lossy tiers (int4/int2/one_bit) were NOT exercised, so this delta does not characterize them.

harness_note: Measured with logits_to_keep=1. An earlier run of this harness materialized logits for every prefill position (seq_len x vocab x 2 bytes = 2.3 GiB at 8192 tokens) and OOMed in the model's lm_head. That OOM was a harness artifact, NOT an ARGUS cache failure. Results taken before that fix are not comparable and were discarded rather than published alongside these.
incomplete: Contexts 512/1024/2048/4096 still need a re-run under the fixed harness. Only 8192 and 16384 below were measured with it.
